description: Update a previously read UTF-8 file using exact text replacements and its expected SHA-256 hash. Paths are workspace-relative unless the user explicitly enabled unrestricted host access.

propertyDescriptions.path: Workspace-relative file path, or an absolute host path only in unrestricted mode.
propertyDescriptions.expectedHash: The full-file SHA-256 version hash returned by the latest successful read_file call for this file.
propertyDescriptions.edits: The ordered exact-text replacements to apply to the verified file version.
propertyDescriptions.edits[].oldText: Existing text that identifies the exact content to replace.
propertyDescriptions.edits[].newText: Replacement text to insert in place of oldText.
propertyDescriptions.edits[].replaceAll: Whether to replace every occurrence when oldText intentionally matches more than one location.

guidance: update_file applies a checked update to a previously read file using its expected hash.
